acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All 4 strategies pass all 5 validation layers: SMA Crossover (L1-L5 all pass), Mean Reversion (L1-L5 all pass), Momentum (L1-L5 all pass, may have DESIGN findings in L2), Multi-Factor (L1-L5 all pass, may have DESIGN findings in L2)

All BUG-classified findings are fixed and verified: each BUG investigated with root cause identified, fix implemented in rustybt codebase, regression test exists for each fixed bug, re-validation confirms fix resolves discrepancy

All DESIGN-classified findings are documented: each DESIGN difference documented in docs/validation/design-differences.md, documentation explains WHY the difference exists, documentation guides users on expected behavior differences, design decisions tagged with framework versions

Validation report generated showing: Strategies Validated = 4, Layers Tested = 20 (5 per strategy), Passed = 20, Failed = 0, all BUGs fixed and verified, all DESIGNs documented, Confidence Level = HIGH
Regression tests exist for all fixed bugs: tests in tests/validation/regression/ directory, each test references original finding ID, tests run as part of CI pipeline
Comprehensive documentation produced: docs/validation/design-differences.md, docs/validation/bug-fixes.md, docs/validation/validation-summary.md
